accounting: Both cache counts are subsets of input_tokens. Their sum must not exceed input_tokens. No additional cache tokens are added to the fixed reservation; all input is already reserved at the cache-write rate.
scope: Real provider and usage validator, scripted transport, in-memory reservation seam; not a repeat of PostgreSQL integration tests.
release: Deploy with prepared owner-test commit only after release executor verifies owner membership, actual Preview ref, existing ledger and credential presence. Start the one-hour window after access readiness. Paid calls only from the user UI; no agent smoke. History and intake remain OFF.
